description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for a WebKitBrowser plugin within the WPEFramework, including JSON data structures, notification handling, and plugin lifecycle methods.

classes.name: CookieJarParamsData
classes.description: JSON data container for browser cookie jar parameters, including version, checksum, and payload.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing web browser functionalities, JSON RPC, and plugin lifecycle management.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Notification handler class for remote connection, state control, web browser, and cookie jar events.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: JSON container for web browser configuration data such as URL, FPS, visibility, and path.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with service information and configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is unloaded.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
